_comment: Fastest path, ~10s on a 4070 Ti Super. AS WIRED THIS GRAPH DOES NOT WORK. LoadImage's MASK output is 1 - alpha, and the TripoSR node uses reference_mask AS the alpha channel, then composites the image over grey. So a transparent cut-out greys out the subject and keeps the background, and an image with no alpha gives a 64x64 zero mask that cannot be joined to the full-size image. It needs an InvertMask between LoadImage slot 1 and reference_mask, and a transparent cut-out. Established from the node source, not yet run.
